response.overview: In the context of John Mark Comer’s new book, Into the quiet: Following Jesus in a world of noise, this documentary explores two key things following the book’s structure. The world of noise. Is it even a problem, objectively? And if so, what defines it and what is it holding back from experiencing it in the spiritual life? What is the answer to noise, and how do we find it when noise is already all around us?
response.tagline: Could God be waiting for us in the quiet?
response.title: The case for quiet
